This is an **optional and ungraded** SQL self-check.

The quiz draws from a **20-question bank** covering SQL Parts 1 and 2. Choose the amount of practice that suits you:

- **5 questions** — quick check
- **10 questions** — standard practice
- **20 questions** — full review

[Start the SQL Self-Check](sql-quiz.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}

::: {.callout-tip}
Do not only ask, **“Does the SQL run?”** Also ask, **“Does it answer the business question?”**
:::
